title: Meow: Create
body:
Meow:Create — A cozy yet ambitious Create server where players shape their own world.
Build massive factories, flying machines, advanced trains and entire industrial empires with 40+ Create addons. Create cities, form nations, make alliances or start conflicts — all driven by the players themselves. Beautiful Terralith world, deep economy, tons of food & decoration mods, and a relaxed atmosphere.
Perfect for those who love big builds, complex automation, and player-driven geopolitics.

Join us and become part of the story! 🐾
